summary: Iteration 2 - verified plain HTML/CSS/JS rewrite (no React). All public pages (Home, Admissions, Gallery, Contact) and admin flows pass. CBSE -> RBSE replacement complete (0 CBSE matches, 4 RBSE on home including footer). Backend not retested (unchanged from iter 1 where 14/14 pytest passed).

issues: Tailwind CSS loaded via cdn.tailwindcss.com - emits production warning in console. Acceptable for preview but should be compiled for production.

critical_code_review_comments: frontend/public/js/app.js: API base is hardcoded as '/api' relative path. Works because frontend and backend share the same ingress in this environment. Acceptable.

frontend/public/index.html: announcements card injection uses string template literals with raw `${a.title}` / `${a.body}` - XSS risk if any field contains HTML. Since data comes from authenticated admin only, low risk but consider HTML-escaping for defense in depth.
frontend/public/admin.html (similar pattern likely elsewhere): direct innerHTML with API data has same caveat.
renderLayout uses string templates for headers/footers - functional, but moves complexity into JS. Consistent across pages, OK.
Mobile menu toggle relies on Tailwind 'hidden' class toggle - works correctly (confirmed by class inspection).
Previous iteration's CORS / brute-force lockout comments still apply (backend unchanged).
test_credentials: admin@azadschool.edu / Admin@2026 (verified working - login redirects to /admin.html)
seed_data_creation: Added 1 TEST_ admission (TEST_Rahul Sharma, class VI) + 1 TEST_ contact (TEST_Visitor) + multiple TEST_ announcements (created and deleted during test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public site is plain multi-page HTML in /app/frontend/public/*.html with shared /js/app.js. Routes work as static files served by CRA dev server on port 3000. Admin uses hash-tabs at /admin.html#section. RBSE replacement done (no CBSE anywhere). Verified flows: home renders + announcements load via /api/announcements; nav links to all .html pages; mobile menu toggle works; admissions 3-step form with input-student-name/dob/gender/class/prev-school then input-parent-name/phone/email then input-address/message and step-3 submit shows admission-success div; gallery filter buttons (filter-all/events/sports/classrooms/infrastructure) clickable; contact form posts and shows success; admin-login wrong creds -> 'Invalid email or password' toast, correct creds -> redirect to /admin.html; admin sidebar has all 5 tabs (overview/admissions/contacts/gallery/announcements); stat-admissions populated (showed value 2 initially); view-admission-<id> opens generic modal (.fixed.inset-0) - no [data-testid='admission-modal'] specifically but works; announcement create+delete works; gallery upload form fields present; logout redirects to /admin-login.html; unauthenticated /admin.html redirects to login (after cookie clear).
rca of the issue: No bugs found. One initial test failure on mobile-menu was a test-script substring bug ('hidden' in 'md:hidden' false-positive); actual toggle works correctly. Initial admissions test failure was wrong field names (test assumed father/mother/city/state fields - app uses single parent-name + address textarea); corrected test passes end-to-end.
